title: Installation.
officialText: Safety or relief valves shall be installed directly into the safety or relief valve opening on the boiler or pressure vessel. Valves shall not be located on either side of a safety or relief valve connection. The safety or relief valve shall dis-charge without obstruction to a nonhazardous point of discharge. The discharge piping shall drain by gravity without traps.
